arabic text: DI THI AMMA NE JO POSHAAK WO LAADO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB, BRING THE CLOTHES THAT MOTHER HAD GIVEN\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: AAJ MAQTAL ME FAQAT BAAT TUMHARI HOGI\nABHI AMMA SE MULAQAT HAMARI HOGI
english translation text: TODAY IN THE BATTLEFIELD, THERE WILL BE ONLY YOUR WORDS\nNOW I WILL BE MEETING OUR MOTHER

arabic text: KOI PAIGHAM AGAR HAI TO SUNA DO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: IF YOU HAVE ANY MESSAGE, THEN LET ME KNOW ZAINAB\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: HATH PABANDE RASAN BEHNA TUMHARE HONGE\nMUJHKO REH REH KE KHAYAL AATA HAI LASHE SE MERE
english translation text: YOUR HANDS WILL BE TIED WITH ROPE MY SISTER\nI KEEP THINKING ABOUT THIS OVER AND OVER, FROM MY BODY

arabic text: TEER KIS TARHA NIKALOGI BATADO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: HOW WILL YOU TAKE OUT THE ARROWS, TELL ME THIS ZAINAB\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: MERE LAASHE KI RAHEGI TUMHE PEHCHAN BAHEN\nCHAAK KARDO MERE KURTE KA GIREHBAAN BAHEN
english translation text: THIS IS HOW YOU WILL BE ABLE TO RECOGNIZE MY DEAD BODY, MY SISTER\nTEAR THE FRONT OF MY SHIRT, MY SISTER

arabic text: KOI LOOTE NA ISE AISA BANADO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: MAKE IT SO THAT NO ONE WILL WANT TO STEAL IT\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: SAAMNE APNE SAKINA (S.A.) SE UTARWA LO GAUHAR\nABHI KUCH DER ME LUT JAEGA MAZLOOM KA GHAR
english translation text: HAVE SAKINA TAKE OFF HER EARRINGS IN FRONT OF YOU\nIN JUST A SHORT WHILE, THE HOUSE OF THE OPPRESSED WILL BE LOOTED

arabic text: YE AMANAT KISI GOSHE ME CHUPA LO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB, HIDE THIS AMAANAT IN SOME CORNER\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: BAHAR AANE KO NA KHAIME SE MAI KEHTA TUMKO\nHOTE ABBAS (A.S.) TO TAKLEEF NA DETA TUMKO
english translation text: I AM NOT TELLING YOU TO COME OUT OF THE TENT\nIF ABBAS WAS HERE, I WOULD NOT GIVE YOU THIS TROUBLE

arabic text: BANAKE ABBAS (A.S.) MUJHE ZEE PE BITHA DO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: BECOME ABBAS AND SEAT ME ON THE SADDLE, ZAINAB\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: QAID KHANE KI SAMBHALO YE AMANAT BIBI\nGOD ME LO ISE MAZLOOM HO RUKHSAT BIBI
english translation text: TAKE CARE OF THIS AMAANAT OF THE PRISON, LADY (ZAINAB)\nTAKE THIS CHILD INTO YOUR LAP SO THE OPPRESSED CAN TAKE HIS LEAVE, LADY (ZAINAB)

arabic text: MERA DAMANNN MERI BACHI SE CHHUDA DO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: SEPARATE MY DAUGHTER FROM MY SHIRTTAILS, ZAINAB\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: JAB SE AKBAR (A.S.) GAYE BEENAI BHI ANKHO KI GAYI\nLAAKE DEDO ALI ASGHAR (A.S.) KI NISHANI KOI
english translation text: SINCE AKBAR WENT, THE LIGHT FROM MY EYES HAS GONE\nBRING ME A REMINDER OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: KURTA BESHEER KA ANKHO SE LAGA DO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: PUT THE SHIRT OF THE SUCKLING BABY ON MY EYES, ZAINAB\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text: GHAR SE SHABBIR (A.S.) JANAZE KI TARHA SE NIKLE\nSAB HI ROTE THE TAKALLUM DARE KHAIMA PE KHADE
english translation text: FROM THE HOME, SHABBIR WENT OUT LIKE A DEAD BODY\nEVERYONE WAS CRYING STANDING AT THE DOOR OF THE TENT

arabic text: SHEH (A.S.) NE JIS DAM KAHA MARNE KI RIZA DO ZAINAB\nAPNE HATHO SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHA DO ZAINAB
english translation text: THE MOMENT HUSAYN SAID ‘GIVE ME PERMISSION TO DIE ZAINAB’\nWITH YOUR HANDS, PUT ON MY KAFAN ZAINAB

arabic text:
SAMNE APNE SAKINA S.A SE UTARWALO GHOHAR
ABHI KUCH DER MEIN LUT JAYE GHA MAZLOOM KA GHAR
YEH AMANAT KISI GHOSHE MEIN CHUPA DHO ZAINAB S.A
APNE HATHON SE KAFAN MUJHKO PINHADO ZAINAB S.A
english translation text:
IN FRONT OF YOURSELF, GET THE EARRINGS FROM SAKINA
NOW SOON THE HOUSE OF THE OPPRESSED PERSON (IMAM HUSAYN) WILL BE DESTROYED
HIDE THIS TRUST IN SOME CORNER O ZAINAB!
DRESS ME UP IN THE SHROUD WITH YOUR HANDS, O ZAINAB!
